prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1456; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you confirm you're okay to proceed?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Great. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection in Pearland?

A: I was making a left turn at a light, heading through the intersection toward a shopping center. The light was green for me, or at least I thought it was. I started to turn and a car coming from the other direction hit the front driver's side of my vehicle.

Q: Were you already in the intersection when the impact happened?

A: Yes, I was partway through the turn. I was almost across the lanes, maybe halfway into the crosswalk area.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the collision?

A: Not really. I looked, but it came up fast. I didn't have time to react.

Q: Do you know if the light was green for them?

A: I can't say for sure. I'd guess it was their light too, but I didn't look at it.

Q: How are you feeling since the accident?

A: My neck is stiff and sore, especially when I turn my head to the left. My lower back aches when I've been sitting for a while. I went to urgent care the same day and they said it looked like strain.

Q: Have you seen anyone else for those symptoms since then?

A: I'm scheduled to see my family doctor next week. I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers and using a heating pad.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the incident?

A: Just that I'm trying to get back to normal. I'd appreciate it if this could move along, since I'm missing some work.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you in writing about next steps.

A: Okay, thank you.
